build_tensormask_package: build the tensormask Python package with C++ and CUDA extensions using setuptools
create_cuda_extension: create a CUDA extension module for tensormask with FP16 support and custom compiler flags
configure_cpp_extension: configure a C++ extension module for tensormask with custom include directories and macros
discover_source_files: discover all C++ and CUDA source files in the tensormask layers csrc directory
setup_pytorch_extension: setup the pytorch BuildExtension command class for building the tensormask C++ extensions
